stories.title: Firefox reunites Numa Numa Guy, Chocolate Rain and Bad Luck Brian
stories.summary: Firefox's "Come Back to Firefox" ad, which debuted during Sunday Night Football, reunited early-internet meme stars and ended with the whole cast doing the Numa Numa dance. Commenters called it "The Avengers for chronically online millennials."

stories.title: Protesters rally against Liberty Mutual's Liberty Biberty mascot
stories.summary: About 100 people rallied outside Liberty Mutual's Boston headquarters against the insurer's fuzzy-ball mascot, chanting "How do we want him? Dead!" One counter-protester came dressed as Biberty.
